# 30-60-90 rollout plan

Fill in owners, dates and your exit criteria. Exit criteria are thresholds you set, not benchmarks. A phase ends when its criteria are met, or when the sponsor agrees to move on and logs why. Method is in `docs/01-align.md` to `docs/05-expand.md`.

**Rollout owner:** [fill in] **Sponsor:** [fill in] **Start date:** [fill in]

## Decision gates

The 30, 60 and 90 day blocks below are a planning aid. The real controls are the gates. Do not pass a gate because the calendar says so.

| Gate | Passes when | Who decides | Date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pilot entry | Sponsor, owner and scope named. Security and data review done. Baseline collected. | Sponsor | [fill in] |
| First evidence review | Scorecard run. Flags read. Support load known. | Rollout owner | [fill in] |
| Midpoint correction | Problems from the first review fixed or logged. Stop conditions checked. | Sponsor | [fill in] |
| Expansion decision | Pre-set triggers met, held, or failed. Outcome evidence reviewed with its limits. | Sponsor | [fill in] |

## Phase 1: days 1 to 30 (enable a pilot)

| Area | Actions | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| Alignment | Success criteria, baseline, decision log | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Security and privacy | Reviews closed, settings documented, verify against current Cursor docs | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Onboarding | Role paths and first-week plan delivered | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Champions | Chosen, chartered, kit shared | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Measurement | Scorecard run weekly, definitions fixed | [fill in] | [fill in] |

**Exit criteria:**

- [ ] All pilot users onboarded with one real task done.
- [ ] No open high security or privacy items.
- [ ] Activated rate at or above [fill in].

## Phase 2: days 31 to 60 (embed habits)

| Area | Actions | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| Use cases | Three to five written workflows | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Shared assets | Rules files and AGENTS.md in pilot repos | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Review gates | Gate agreed and in use | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Support | Office hours running, question log reviewed | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Re-engagement | Contact people who dropped after week two | [fill in] | [fill in] |

**Exit criteria:**

- [ ] Sustained rate at or above [fill in] in pilot teams.
- [ ] Users with agent sessions at or above [fill in].
- [ ] Review wait and quality no worse than baseline.

## Phase 3: days 61 to 90 (measure and decide)

| Area | Actions | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| Outcomes | Compare to baseline, write the cannot-attribute note | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Survey | Short survey run, results shared back | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Costs | Spend reviewed against budget | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Executive review | One-pager sent, 30-minute meeting held | [fill in] | [fill in] |
| Next wave | Teams and triggers proposed | [fill in] | [fill in] |

**Exit criteria:**

- [ ] Decision logged: expand, hold, or fix first.
- [ ] Owners and dates set for the next phase.
